dedupe_keys.name: a benchmark dataset for binary segmentation and quantification of dust emissions from unsealed roads

description: A benchmark dataset for binary segmentation and quantification of dust emissions from unsealed roads is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Asanka De Silva et al. The generation of reference data for machine learning models is challenging for dust emissions due to perpetually dynamic environmental conditions. We generated a new vision dataset with the goal of advancing semantic segmentation to identify and quantify vehicle-induced dust clouds from images. Coverage: not stated; published in 2023. Formats: Excel, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1409513291 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
